shortDescription: CGPSC Sub Inspector (SI) / Subedar / Platoon Commander Prelims Result 2026 out on 04 Aug 2026. Download PDF at psc.cg.gov.in.
content:
The Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC) has declared the Prelims / Written Result 2026 for recruitment to Subedar, Sub Inspector Cadre and Platoon Commander under the Home (Police) Department (2024 cycle).

Result PDF was published around 04 August 2026 on the official CGPSC website. Qualified candidates should prepare for the next stage (Mains / further process) as per the official schedule.

Posts covered

  • Subedar
  • Sub Inspector (SI) Cadre
  • Platoon Commander

How to check

  1. Visit psc.cg.gov.in
  2. Open Result section
  3. Download Subedar / Sub Inspector Cadre & Platoon Commander Prelims Written Exam Result PDF
  4. Search roll number
  5. Note Mains / next stage dates from official notice
